title: CoreWeave股价重挫 信用市场定价违约概率上升
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Now Core Weave shares also plunged 15% as its bonds hit levels that typically indicate distress.
segments.zh: CoreWeave股价也大跌15%，其债券收益率触及通常预示压力的水平。

segments.en: Critic default swaps are pricing in a more than 50% chance of default within the next five years.
segments.zh: 信用违约互换市场定价显示，未来五年内违约概率超过50%。

segments.en: But CEO Mike Intrata says the market is acting rationally and he remains confident in the company's business model. Let's get to San Francisco now for more with our ticket to Nick Turner.
segments.zh: 但CEO Mike Intrator表示市场反应理性，他仍对公司商业模式充满信心。现在连线旧金山的Nick Turner了解更多。

segments.en: So Nick, something to see here or nothing to see here as the Core Weave CEO says.
segments.zh: Nick，CoreWeave CEO说的情况，是有实质问题还是没什么可担心的？

segments.en: I'm sure it's something in between those two extremes, but this is a company that's obviously been a very successful one of the biggest IPOs last year with a promise of building out the AI
segments.zh: 我相信情况介于两个极端之间，但这家公司显然是去年最成功的IPO之一，承诺要建设AI基础设施。

segments.en: infrastructure. It's a category of companies we call Neo Clouds and it certainly has tremendous
segments.zh: 这类公司我们称之为新云，它确实拥有巨大的

segments.en: to be too great. But as you mentioned, the CEO is confident that the, you know, the company's on track and that it's going to have enough orders to be able to cover its debts.
segments.zh: 过高。但如你所说，CEO有信心公司步入正轨，将有足够订单来覆盖债务。
